businesses.business: B2B e-commerce marketplace for large parcel furniture and home goods

offering_description.value: Operates a global B2B online marketplace connecting manufacturers, mostly in Asia, with resellers in the US, Europe and Asia, selling large parcel products such as furniture. Provides integrated logistics: warehousing, fulfillment and last-mile delivery. Also sells furniture directly through its own brands and retail platforms.

primary_products.value: furniture; home furnishings; large parcel home goods; outdoor and fitness equipment

primary_services.value: B2B marketplace access; warehousing and fulfillment; last-mile delivery; cross-border logistics

customer_segment.value: B2B: Resellers, online retailers and marketplace sellers buying large parcel goods, suppliers using the platform; B2C: Consumers buying furniture through own online retail sites and third-party marketplaces

end_markets.value: furniture; home furnishings; e-commerce retail; home improvement

revenue_model.value: product sales: Furniture and home goods sold to marketplace resellers and own-brand products; service fees: Marketplace commissions, fulfillment, warehousing, delivery and logistics fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Runs B2B marketplace linking manufacturers and resellers; distributor: Buys from manufacturers and sells large parcel goods to resellers; service provider: Provides warehousing, fulfillment and last-mile delivery; brand owner: Sells own-brand furniture made by contract manufacturers
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; distributor; service provider; brand owner

geography_served.value: global: Marketplace spanning Asia-based suppliers and buyers in the US, Europe, Japan and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Marketplace, logistics services and furniture product sales, focused on large parcel goods

distribution_channels.value: online: GigaCloud Marketplace platform and own e-commerce sites; direct sales: Direct sales to resellers and large retail accounts; third-party retail: Online marketplaces and retailers selling to end consumers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Customs, trade tariffs, product safety and import rules, plus transport and data privacy regulation
